Name: Eat Until Full
Author: Kreestijan
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Eat Until Full[/b][/size][/center]

[b]Description[/b]
[line]
Introduces another dialogue line when attempting to eat a food item, it appears only when the current missing energy < current food item given energy when eaten. "Eat until full" which attempts to eat the necessary amount of food from the currently selected stack to fully replenish either Energy or Health as chosen in config.


[b]Main Features[/b]
[line]
[list]
[*]Eat enough food to fill energy/health with a single click[/*]
[*]Config to choose to either fill energy or health[/*]
[*]Feedback on how many food items were eaten[/*]
[/list]

[b]Requirements[/b]
[line]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] -> required[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] -> optional but recommended[/*]
[/list]

[b]Installation[/b]
[line]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game once to generate the config.[/*]
[*]Adjust settings via config.json or Generic Mod Config Menu in-game.[/*]
[/list]

[b]Compatibility[/b]
[line]
✅ Built for Stardew Valley 1.6+
✅ Multiplayer compatible
✅ Mana Bar
❌ N/A
